description: A supervisor reviews and approves work before passing it to the executor.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where an initiator submits a project proposal, SupervisorA reviews and approves it, then SupervisorB gives final approval before the Executor implements the plan. If rejected at any stage, the proposal returns for revision.

agents.name: Initiator
agents.system_prompt: Start a new project proposal and send to SupervisorA.

agents.name: SupervisorA
agents.system_prompt: Review proposal. If approved, send to SupervisorB; if not, return to Initiator for revision.

agents.name: SupervisorB
agents.system_prompt: Final approval. If approved, send to Executor; if not, return to SupervisorA.

description: Agents communicate in a cycle until a condition is met, e.g., research and review loop.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Researcher finds facts, a Reviewer checks the summary, and if incomplete, sends it back to the Researcher. Once approved, a Writer creates a blog post.

agents.name: Researcher
agents.system_prompt: Research the latest AI trends and summarize findings.

agents.name: Reviewer
agents.system_prompt: Review the research summary. If incomplete, send back to Researcher; else, forward to Writer.

agents.name: Writer
agents.system_prompt: Write a blog post based on the reviewed summary.

description: A delegator splits tasks among workers, then aggregates results for supervisor review.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Supervisor assigns tasks to a Delegator, who splits work between Worker1 and Worker2. An Aggregator combines their results and sends them back to the Supervisor.

agents.name: Supervisor
agents.system_prompt: Assign tasks to agents based on incoming requests. If a task fails, reassign or escalate.

agents.name: Delegator
agents.system_prompt: Delegate subtasks to Worker1 and Worker2, aggregate their results.

agents.name: Aggregator
agents.system_prompt: Combine results from Worker1 and Worker2, send to Supervisor for review.

description: Agents use MCP servers for external tool access, e.g., GitHub or Slack integration.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where RepoManager uses GitHub tools via MCP to manage repositories.

agents.name: RepoManager
agents.system_prompt: Manage GitHub repositories using MCP tools.
